items.text: I love conversations that dig into big ideas.
My eyes glaze over when a topic gets abstract.
A beautiful piece of music can stop me in my tracks.
I don't see the point of visiting art galleries.
I finish my part of a project well before the deadline.
I waste whole afternoons scrolling instead of working.
A cluttered desk makes it hard for me to relax.
Leaving dishes in the sink for days doesn't bother me.
I light up when a party finally gets going.
It takes a lot to get me visibly excited.
In meetings, I'm usually the first one to speak up.
I'd rather follow someone else's plan than push my own.
I check in on friends who go quiet in the group chat.
Other people's problems don't really stay on my mind.
I go out of my way to avoid arguing with people.
I enjoy pushing back when someone tells me what to do.
Little things can flip my mood in seconds.
I keep my cool even when everything goes wrong at once.
After an awkward moment, I replay it in my head for days.
I rarely worry about how things might go wrong.
